title: ネオン・フライヤーの不眠症的デバッグ
author: ネオ・カナタ

en.title: Neon Flyer's Insomniac Debugging
en.premise: In the Sleepless Dome, a city where sleep is forbidden, I make a living as a 'memory scavenger,' debugging illegal electronic lifeforms known as 'Migratory Birds' that drift through the system. One day, my terminal receives the consciousness data of a girl harboring a bug powerful enough to rewrite every log in the city. While evading the pursuit of the city's management AI, I draw closer to the truth behind a bug far too beautiful to be real, hidden in the depths of the city that never sleeps.

zh.title: 霓虹飞行员的失眠式调试
zh.premise: 在禁止睡眠的都市“不眠之穹”中，我一边从事着“记忆拾荒”的工作，一边承接调试非法漂流在系统中的电子生命体——通称“候鸟”的任务。直到有一天，我的终端收到了一份少女的意识数据，她携带的Bug足以改写整座都市的所有日志。在躲避都市管理AI追击的同时，我逐渐接近隐藏在不眠之城底端、那个过于美丽的Bug的真相。
